automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount Service Account token in pod

bitnami/common

configuration.description:
Configure ZooKeeper with a custom zoo.cfg file
e.g:
configuration: |-
deploy-working-dir=/bitnami/zookeeper/data
log-level=info
...

customLivenessProbe.description: Custom livenessProbe that overrides the default one

customReadinessProbe.description: Custom readinessProbe that overrides the default one

customStartupProbe.description: Custom startupProbe that overrides the default one

dataLogDir.description:
Dedicated data log directory
This allows a dedicated log device to be used, and helps avoid competition between logging and snapshots.
E.g.
dataLogDir: /bitnami/zookeeper/dataLog

diagnosticMode.description: Enable diagnostic mode in the statefulset

dnsConfig.description:
allows users more control on the DNS settings for a Pod. Required if `dnsPolicy` is set to `None`
The dnsConfig field is optional and it can work with any dnsPolicy settings.
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-dns-config
E.g.
dnsConfig:
nameservers:
- 192.0.2.1 # this is an example
searches:
- ns1.svc.cluster-domain.example
- my.dns.search.suffix
options:
- name: ndots
value: "2"
- name: edns0

dnsPolicy.description:
Specifies the DNS policy for the zookeeper pods
DNS policies can be set on a per-Pod basis. Currently Kubernetes supports the following Pod-specific DNS policies.
Available options: Default, ClusterFirst, ClusterFirstWithHostNet, None
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-s-dns-policy

enableServiceLinks.description:
Whether information about services should be injected into pod's environment variable
The environment variables injected by service links are not used, but can lead to slow boot times or slow running of the scripts when there are many services in the current namespace.
If you experience slow pod startups or slow running of the scripts you probably want to set this to `false`.
DNS-Pod services
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/

existingConfigmap.description:
The name of an existing ConfigMap with your custom configuration for ZooKeeper
NOTE: When it's set the `configuration` parameter is ignored

extraDeploy.description: Extra objects to deploy (evaluated as a template)

extraEnvVars.description:
Array with extra environment variables to add to ZooKeeper nodes
e.g:
extraEnvVars:
- name: FOO
value: "bar"

extraEnvVarsCM.description: Name of existing ConfigMap containing extra env vars for ZooKeeper nodes

extraEnvVarsSecret.description: Name of existing Secret containing extra env vars for ZooKeeper nodes

extraVolumeMounts.description:
Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeMounts for the ZooKeeper container(s)
Example Use Case: mount certificates to enable TLS
e.g:
extraVolumeMounts:
- name: zookeeper-keystore
mountPath: /certs/keystore
readOnly: true
- name: zookeeper-truststore
mountPath: /certs/truststore
readOnly: true

extraVolumes.description:
Optionally specify extra list of additional volumes for the ZooKeeper pod(s)
Example Use Case: mount certificates to enable TLS
e.g:
extraVolumes:
- name: zookeeper-keystore
secret:
defaultMode: 288
secretName: zookeeper-keystore
- name: zookeeper-truststore
secret:
defaultMode: 288
secretName: zookeeper-truststore

fourlwCommandsWhitelist.description: A list of comma separated Four Letter Words commands that can be executed

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override common.names.fullname template

heapSize.description:
Size (in MB) for the Java Heap options (Xmx and Xms)
This env var is ignored if Xmx an Xms are configured via `jvmFlags`

initContainers.description:
Add additional init containers to the ZooKeeper pod(s)
Example:
initContainers:
- name: your-image-name
image: your-image
imagePullPolicy: Always
ports:
- name: portname
containerPort: 1234
ZooKeeper Pod Disruption Budget
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/disruptions/

initLimit.description: ZooKeeper uses to limit the length of time the ZooKeeper servers in quorum have to connect to a leader

jvmFlags.description: Default JVM flags for the ZooKeeper process

lifecycleHooks.description:
for the ZooKeeper container(s) to automate configuration before or after startup
ZooKeeper resource requests and limits
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-compute-resources-container/

listenOnAllIPs.description: Allow ZooKeeper to listen for connections from its peers on all available IP addresses

logLevel.description:
Log level for the ZooKeeper server. ERROR by default
Have in mind if you set it to INFO or WARN the ReadinessProve will produce a lot of logs

maxClientCnxns.description: Limits the number of concurrent connections that a single client may make to a single member of the ZooKeeper ensemble

maxSessionTimeout.description:
Maximum session timeout (in milliseconds) that the server will allow the client to negotiate
Defaults to 20 times the tickTime

minServerId.description:
Minimal SERVER_ID value, nodes increment their IDs respectively
Servers increment their ID starting at this minimal value.
E.g., with `minServerId=10` and 3 replicas, server IDs will be 10, 11, 12 for z-0, z-1 and z-2 respectively.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override common.names.fullname template (will maintain the release name)

namespaceOverride.description:
Override namespace for ZooKeeper resources
Useful when including ZooKeeper as a chart dependency, so it can be released into a different namespace than the parent

nodeSelector.description:
Node labels for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/

persistence.description:
Enable persistence using Persistent Volume Claims
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/

podAffinityPreset.description:
Pod affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podAntiAffinityPreset.description:
Pod anti-affinity preset. Ignored if `affinity` is set. Allowed values: `soft` or `hard`
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity

podLabels.description:
Extra labels for ZooKeeper pods
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podManagementPolicy.description:
StatefulSet controller supports relax its ordering guarantees while preserving its uniqueness and identity guarantees. There are two valid pod management policies: `OrderedReady` and `Parallel`
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/stateful-application/basic-stateful-set/#pod-management-policy

priorityClassName.description:

Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/pod-priority-preemption/
